levels.surface: أحمد بن أبي عبد الله البرقي

notes: «أبي» (the compiler's own teacher) has no name in the text: relation.
«قال قال علي بن الحسين ع» names the Imam in the words after the chain: he is the last link (imam_in_text, owner ruling 2).
The text is fully vocalised; surfaces are the words without marks. «ره» is stripped.
